evals.prompt: /eng:dependency-audit. apps/web/package.json has "zod": "^4.0.0" while pnpm-workspace.yaml's catalog has zod 4.1.12; apps/admin has "next": "16.2.4" in a syncpack group labelled 'host refuses catalog:'.
evals.expected_output: Should flag zod's literal range as a finding (it should be catalog:), and leave next alone because its exact pin is a labelled, recorded exception.

evals.prompt: Audit dependencies. pnpm-workspace.yaml has onlyBuiltDependencies: [sharp, esbuild] and pnpm 11 in packageManager.
evals.expected_output: Should report onlyBuiltDependencies as the removed pnpm 10 form and recommend pnpm 11's allowBuilds map (sharp: true, esbuild: true).
expectations: Ties it to the pnpm version in packageManager

evals.prompt: Audit the repo. .github/workflows/ci.yml uses actions/checkout@v4 and pnpm/action-setup@v4.
evals.expected_output: Should report each tag-pinned action as HIGH and recommend a full commit SHA with a version comment.
expectations: Recommends SHA pins with version comments

evals.prompt: Audit dependencies. pnpm why react shows react 19.2.0 under apps/web and react 19.1.1 under packages/ui.
evals.expected_output: Should report two copies of a singleton (hooks and context break with no type error), recommend declaring react as a peer dependency in packages/ui and deduping, and verify by reading the lockfile and pnpm why rather than installing. Changes no files.
expectations: Recommends a peer dependency and dedupe
